ops.text: drive job report from a Sprite lane relays to the coordinator's Mac and prints only 'no answer in 9 minutes ... read what it would change before asking again', yet a lane may not run drive job show to read whether the report was kept, so the lane cannot tell a kept report from a lost one; a refusal arrives later as an orchestration message, a success arrives as nothing. The relay should answer the lane with the verb's outcome, or allow a read-only job show.
